entities.summary: Oscar Liwaal is a Ghanaian politician. He is a member of the Eighth Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana representing the Yunyoo Constituency in the Yunyoo-Nasuan District in the North East Region of Ghana. He was a former chief executive officer for Bunkpurugu Yunyoo and Yunyoo-Nasuan district respectively.
